title: A frameshift mutation
caption: Deleting one base shifts the reading frame, so every codon after it changes. Inserting or deleting three bases would instead add or remove a single amino acid.
alt: The start of the beta-globin coding strand and the same sequence with one base deleted from the seventh codon; every later codon is read differently.
description: One G is deleted from the seventh codon.
The bases after it are read in a new frame, so the amino acids after the deletion all change.
A deletion of 3 bases would not shift the frame.
